experiments.question: Which published directory entries have complete item-level source reconciliation, and why are the rest held?

primary_endpoint.name: complete_source_reconciliation_coverage
primary_endpoint.definition: Entries with complete item-level reconciliation receipts divided by all published entries in the frozen directory snapshot; report edition-level counts separately.
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: Descriptive census: report all entries and all held reasons; no pass threshold.

experiments.question: How reliably do the retained methods distinguish five directed requirement relations against an independent model-agent reference?

primary_endpoint.name: reference_relative_false_equivalence
primary_endpoint.definition: Predicted-equivalent outputs that disagree with a usable locked model-agent reference, divided only by predicted-equivalent outputs with a usable locked reference. Report unresolved equivalent predictions and reference coverage separately; unresolved cases cannot dilute the error rate.
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: Descriptive qualification until sample size, grouped uncertainty and numerical adoption limits are frozen; no automatic admission.

experiments.question: Does adding LiquidAI/d1-2B find supported material errors missed by the retained baseline at the same review budget?

primary_endpoint.name: incremental_supported_errors_per_100_reviews
primary_endpoint.definition: Difference between augmented and baseline triage in reference-confirmed material errors per 100 reviewed pairs at the same frozen review budget.
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: Freeze a minimum useful paired gain and tolerated added error before execution; standalone model superiority is not required; keep outputs advisory.

freeze_blockers: Pin the complete directory snapshot and all source/input manifests with exact hashes.
Select untouched guideline families, natural pair sampling, target family counts and grouped confidence method; retain development and synthetic cases separately.
Freeze E2 numerical adoption limits and E3 review budget, minimum useful gain, and tolerated added error before evaluation outputs.
Pin adjudicator versions/prompts and record independent source-only task boundaries.
Qualify d1-2B model, licence, weights, tokenizer, reviewed local code and runtime in the existing isolated experiment lane; remote model execution remains prohibited.
Record protocol/design decision evidence in Git before experimental execution.

claims.text: The profile can represent diverse reporting standards with auditable source and semantic fidelity.
limitations: Proposed contribution; no directory-wide qualification or EQUATOR endorsement.

claims.text: Orthogonal decision-model evidence improves supported discrepancy discovery at a fixed review budget.
limitations: Hypothesis, not an observed result; correlated errors and domain calibration require measurement.
